name: a session left open by an OS kill gets a synthetic end, and a relaunch inside the window continues it
source: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-01-e2e-fixes/R1-sdk.md Task 2 — Adjust's lastActivity model (a launch within the session interval of the last activity is a sub-session). Replaces the retired sdk-core rule that split every killed session: with no heartbeat the last known activity is the sub-session's start, so the orphan is closed there (activeMs 0) and the relaunch, 5 s later, is a sub-session. Order matters: the end is emitted before anything the relaunch emits.
